title: Listen to Bernie
content:
Whoever leads the Democratic majority in the Senate must have the support of Bernie Sanders.

At the beginning of Sanders' running for president, I didn't like him. I thought HRC was a much better choice.

Maybe the electorate wasn't ready for him. I sure wasn't. But now, last week's election was his validation.

This is our second chance to get past the toxic combination of the Repub leadership and the Dem leadership. If we're going to have a war it has to come from our strength. Ideally there will be no war because the American people, believe it or not, are willing to give Bernie a chance now.

We all voted for that. Schumer thinks we voted for him.

Two old Jewish men, one who defined our future and one who history has passed by, who doesn't know it yet.
